gen-tourney-gf-geom: Tourney cuts every stroke to one width, stretched wide. Geom, a plain sans with a lofty lowercase, feels friendly and current beside that athletic, bulky heading.
gen-tourney-gf-hammersmith-one: Tourney stretches its bulky little letters wide, every stroke cut to one width. Hammersmith One, a sans-serif of rounded, cord-like strokes with capitals barely above lowercase, would read smooth and clean across a long passage.
gen-tourney-gf-inder: Athletic and bold, Tourney draws every stroke alike, so up and side strokes look identical. Inder, a sans-serif, does the quiet reading work.
gen-tourney-gf-jaldi: Approachable and professional, Jaldi pairs with Tourney's bold athletic build. Its tall x-height and gaping c keep a long stretch of text open and easy going.
gen-tourney-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Tourney looks cut with a fixed-width router bit, bold and athletic. Kdam Thmor Pro, a sans-serif whose bowls fill the line, can take a slightly generous size.
gen-tourney-gf-krona-one: Krona One reads broad and loosely spaced, its lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Krona One, set against Tourney, would feel steady and approachable over a long passage.
gen-tourney-gf-magra: Magra reads big-bodied in every lowercase word, a sans with a professional hush. Magra handles the reading, while Tourney, drawn as if with a fixed pen, handles the shouting.
gen-tourney-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono is a monospace with generous curve openings and loose, far-apart letters, structured and technical. And Tourney's wide, bulky athletic lettering sits above it like a scoreboard over a terminal.
gen-tourney-gf-matemasie: Tourney is bold and athletic, its bulky small letters stretched by wide tracking and every stroke cut alike. Matemasie, a sans with broad gaps, reads clean and steady.
gen-tourney-gf-menbere: Tourney stitches its bold, athletic letters along one thread-like stroke width, stretched wide and bulky. Menbere, a sans with tall rolled-cord lowercase, can stay modest in size.
